title: Restoration of Li+ pathways in the [010] direction during direct regeneration for spent LiFePO4
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,3750-3760
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE00641D, Paper
Shuaipeng Hao, Yuelin Lv, Yi Zhang, Shuaiwei Liu, Zhouliang Tan, Wei Liu, Yuanguang Xia, Wen Yin, Yaqi Liao, Haijin Ji, Yuelin Kong, Yudi Shao, Yunhui Huang, Lixia Yuan
TA is employed as a reducing agent to supply electrons in the hydrothermal reaction, followed by brief annealing to restore the Li+ diffusion pathways along the [010] direction and facilitate the re-intercalation of Li+ in spent LFP.
